segments.name: Central America
segments.description: Operates warehouse clubs that sell consumable and non-consumable merchandise and services to members in Central America.
segments.evidence: As of August 31, 2026 , we had 58 warehouse clubs in operation in Central America, the Caribbean and Colombia.

segments.name: Caribbean
segments.description: Operates warehouse clubs that sell consumable and non-consumable merchandise and services to members in the Caribbean.
segments.evidence: PriceSmart sources approximately half of its merchandise from suppliers within Latin America and the Caribbean, with the balance of merchandise sourced from the United States and globally.

segments.name: Colombia
segments.description: Operates warehouse clubs that sell consumable and non-consumable merchandise and services to members in Colombia.
segments.evidence: Our operations currently consist of four reportable segments: Central America, the Caribbean, Colombia and the United States.

segments.name: United States
segments.description: Operates warehouse clubs that sell consumable and non-consumable merchandise and services to members in the United States.
segments.evidence: Our operating segments currently are the United States, Central America, the Caribbean and Colombia.

revenueModel.text: Members pay membership fees and buy merchandise and services at PriceSmart warehouse clubs.
revenueModel.evidence: PriceSmart's mission is to provide all Members an outstanding shopping experience with high quality, exciting merchandise and services at the lowest possible prices.
